description: This file is a shell script (bash/sh) that contains automated tests for Git status and merge conflict scenarios, including conflict detection, diff outputs, and conflict resolution states.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success with a given command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with given files and message.

methods.name: test_diff
methods.description: Checks differences between commits or index.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock for testing.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
